record.question: What is considered an absolute contraindication for a percutaneous nephrostomy procedure?
options: An uncorrectable bleeding diathesis (abnormal blood coagulation)
record.explanation: Official final key: B — An uncorrectable bleeding diathesis (abnormal blood coagulation). MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 8, printed Q5. Source limitation: Bleeding diathesis is commonly a relative contraindication for nephrostomy, particularly urgent infected obstruction; absolute wording needs matched primary policy. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
